name: adc_init
comment: Initializes ADC3 for the capacitive matrix; ADC5 is used for other measurements.

name: transport_uart_init
comment: UART0 at 115200 baud in the wireless path; PC3 controls the external module.

name: board_init
comment: GPIO, clock, ADC, timer, UART and interface initialization.

name: rgb_timer_update
comment: RGB update called from TMR1_IRQHandler.

name: rgb_effect_dispatch
comment: Selector 0..14; ARMCC inline jump table manually resolved.

name: uart_send_staged_bytes
comment: Writes the staged frame to UART0 using the TX-full flag.

name: ble_report_queue_service
comment: Sends queued reports to the external wireless module.

name: ble_key_event
comment: Maps internal key codes into reports for the UART transport.

name: CLK_DisableModuleClock
comment: NUC123 peripheral clock gate operations.

name: CLK_EnableModuleClock
comment: NUC123 module identifier and peripheral clock gate operations.

name: CLK_SetModuleClock
comment: Selects peripheral clock source and divider using encoded module ID.

name: delay_ms
comment: Repeated SysTick polling with millisecond-scale counter.

name: delay_us
comment: SysTick polling used for ADC acquisition settling time.

name: eeprom_write_block
comment: Splits writes across 128-byte EEPROM page boundaries.

name: eeprom_write_page
comment: Software I2C transaction to EEPROM address 0xa0.

name: eeprom_read_block
comment: Software I2C block read.

name: eeprom_read_u8
comment: Software I2C random byte read through PA10/PA11.

name: FMC_ErasePage
comment: FMC erase command and completion polling.

name: FMC_ReadWord
comment: FMC read command and completion polling.

name: FMC_WriteWord
comment: FMC word program command and completion polling.

name: GPIO_SetMode
comment: Sets two-bit pin mode fields selected by pin mask.

name: usb_endpoint_init
comment: Initializes control, programming and keyboard HID endpoints.

name: ec_timer_sample
comment: Selects acquisition method according to RGB activity.

name: ec_sample_row_rgb
comment: Samples all six columns then advances the 11-row mux.

name: ec_sample_column
comment: Samples one column per call and queues a record after six columns.

name: key_events_dispatch
comment: Processes matrix events, mappings, function keys, repeat and macro definitions.

name: ec_keyboard_init
comment: Loads stored calibration and thresholds, initializes matrix and scan buffers.

name: ec_process_scan_records
comment: 11x6 matrix, baseline subtraction, 5/18-percent coupling correction, 3-frame debounce.

name: ble_send_frame
comment: Minimum 10-byte UART frame; additive 8-bit checksum.

name: configuration_factory_reset
comment: Writes factory settings, nine groups of 66 key definitions and default RGB data to EEPROM.

name: ec_select_row
comment: Row selector: PD0/PD1/PD2, PA13/PA14; row inputs 0..10.

name: ps2_key_event
comment: Encodes key events for the PS/2 peripheral.

name: firmware_verify_staging_sum
comment: Checks staged EEPROM image against the accumulated byte sum.

name: host_send_press_counters
comment: Streams 66 little-endian 32-bit counters, then 0xe6 terminator.

name: host_send_key_configuration
comment: Streams 9x66 key definitions, then 0xf6 terminator.

name: ec_read_column_adc
comment: Active-low column gates PC12..PC8 and PA15; reads ten-bit ADC3.

name: host_send_rgb_configuration
comment: Streams the 198-byte RGB configuration, then 0xe6 terminator.

name: ec_measure_idle_level
comment: Averages fifty ADC3 readings.

name: host_command_dispatch
comment: Dispatches HID commands for update, key configuration, RGB and counters.

name: des_rotate_bit_buffer
comment: Bit-buffer rotation helper used by the DES implementation.

name: des_ecb_decrypt
comment: Firmware DES function: key buffer zeroed, only caller key byte 0 copied; independently emulated.

name: SYS_UnlockReg
comment: Writes 0x59, 0x16, 0x88 to protected-register lock.

name: host_send_version
comment: Responds to host version command 0xf9.

name: clock_set_profile
comment: Selects clock and PLL profiles for active and low-power modes.

name: SystemInit
comment: Empty SystemInit hook called by Reset_Handler.

name: application_init
comment: Loads settings, initializes EC thresholds, macros, counters and transport state.

name: firmware_update_record
comment: Decrypts and validates Intel HEX records, stages data in EEPROM and handles completion.

name: des_permute_bits
comment: Bit-permutation helper used for DES IP, PC1 and other tables.

name: UART_EnableInt
comment: UART interrupt enable and NVIC setup.

name: UART_Open
comment: UART baud-rate and line-control configuration.

name: usb_key_event
comment: Maps internal key codes into USB keyboard, extended and mouse reports.

name: usb_report_queue_service
comment: Services the queued USB reports.

name: report_state_clear
comment: Clears transport report buffers and key state.

name: usb_send_host_payload
comment: Copies bytes into USBD hardware endpoint 3 buffer (wire endpoint 0x82).

name: watchdog_init
comment: Watchdog configuration.

name: watchdog_feed
comment: Watchdog refresh called throughout foreground loops.

name: memory_fill
comment: Byte fill helper.

name: soft_i2c_write_byte
comment: GPIO PA10 data, PA11 clock, sends MSB first and clocks ACK.

name: soft_i2c_start
comment: GPIO I2C START sequence; preserves r3 in the machine code.

name: soft_i2c_stop
comment: GPIO I2C STOP sequence; preserves r3 in the machine code.
